item.title: The Bytes Moved, the Compute Didn't: Ten Years of Path Dependence in Decentralized Databases
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: the field’s unsolved problem is not that consensus is too weak, it is that compute never followed the bytes. A database is not one thing — it is four: write order, byte location, execution location, read permission. Six routes, and each one bought exactly one of them.

item.title: SecLog, read closely: letting a delivery leave its own receipt
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: “the user cannot deny receiving the data” needs no trusted API and no data on chain — only a design where the last half of the decryption key can appear through one path, and that path leaves a record. Just over two minutes: how a key becomes a log entry → the two events and what each one proves → the 8,000-gas gap, and why I could not reproduce the absolute number.
